supercharger_access.notes: Fisker is not on the InsideEVs 2026 list of brands with Supercharger access. Fisker signed a Tesla agreement in Aug 2023 covering "all current and future Fisker vehicles" with adapters promised from Q1 2025 (Cars.com excerpt), but Fisker filed for Chapter 11 on 2024-06-17 and no shipped adapter was found, so `no` is the current state as far as known.
